name: Loot rebalance: full crates, no chest gold, more unidentified gear, monsters drop consumables

evidence.semantics: Crates never come up empty (gold/consumables ~44 % each), wooden and iron chests never drop gold (that share becomes consumables) and enchant 50 % / 100 %, monsters (single player) drop from a consumable-only table (no Valuing Scroll, Angel Wing, Grenade; accessories and pastes kept) 1 in 4 plus a Valuing Scroll 1/32. Hard-mode rows likewise. Monster potions: Herb only (and Goddess Tear) in dungeons 1-5 and 18, Herb/Healing Drop elsewhere, Herb/Drop/Water and Goddess Tear/Ray of Hope in hard mode, uniformly.
evidence.runtime: runtime_verified (English ROM + mod, normal mode, single player, visible input only): loot_verify.py on Crate/Wooden_Chest/Iron_Chest.ss0 delays 0-24, 75/75 breaks match loot_model on the patched lists (crate never empty, all iron-chest gear unidentified); Patches/loot_rebalance/test_monster.py on Easy_Kill.ss0 delays 0-199, 200/200 kill rolls match, 50 generic drops, none an Angel Wing/Grenade; with --hard (diagnostic flag write) 200/200 match and the generator reads row 80. Real hard-mode game and multiplayer not tested. Potion re-pick: test_monster.py 600/600 (normal, --hard, vanilla) incl. the re-pick RNG; test_potions.py (diagnostic forced drops and injected codes) 720/720 allowed across dungeons 1-5, 18, 6, 7, 17, 19 and hard.
